signals.name: silence
signals.description: All zeros. Spectrum must be exactly zero in every bin.

signals.name: dc-offset
signals.description: Constant 0.5. All energy in bin 0 (DC), nothing elsewhere.

signals.name: single-tone-450hz
signals.description: Pure 450 Hz sine = bin 18 exactly. One sharp peak, no leakage.

signals.name: two-tone-dtmf
signals.description: DTMF '1' (697+1209 Hz). Not bin-aligned, so leakage is visible.

signals.name: chirp-linear
signals.description: Linear sweep 200->3000 Hz. Broadband, time-varying content.

signals.name: white-noise
signals.description: Seeded Gaussian noise. Flat-ish spectrum, stability stress test.

signals.name: nyquist-tone
signals.description: Alternating +1/-1. All energy at bin 256 (fs/2). Edge case.

signals.name: impulse
signals.description: Unit impulse at sample 0. Magnitude must be flat (1.0) in all bins.

signals.name: full-scale-clipping
signals.description: 1 kHz tone (bin 40) hard-clipped. Odd harmonics, must not overflow.
